title: preflight_checklist
description: Machine-readable gate manifest emitted by integrate-repo Step 5. Single source of truth for the gate list shared by remediate_compliance.sh and run_ci_preflight.sh. Replace every REPLACE_* value; delete unused gate entries rather than leaving placeholders.

gates.fix_command: REPLACE e.g. ruff check --fix <target>, or null if verifier-only
gates.pin_source: lockfile | pre-commit rev | action input | run-step pin | manifest range | UNPINNED
gates.ci_command: REPLACE the original CI command, before alias resolution
gates.applies_because: path argument | working-directory | on.paths filter | config include

stage_order.name: codemods
stage_order.why: rewrites AST shapes; invalidates everything downstream

stage_order.name: import-sort
stage_order.why: changes line counts; must precede line-sensitive steps

stage_order.name: lint-fix
stage_order.why: may emit correct but unformatted code

stage_order.name: format
stage_order.why: must run last so the formatter has the final say on layout

stage_order.name: mechanical
stage_order.why: git mv renames and idempotent header injection

contributing_requirements.note: Process gates a script cannot verify. Confirm manually before opening a PR.
